cards.text: Two kingdoms now: Israel and Judah. Jehoash son of Jehoahaz is in his second year as king of Israel when Amaziah becomes king of Judah. Amaziah is twenty-five, and he'll reign in Jerusalem twenty-nine years.

cards.question: True or false: Amaziah, the new king of Judah, does what is right in the eyes of the LORD.

cards.text: There's a catch, though: he does right, but not as his ancestor King David had done. Like a cookie that comes out done but never quite turns golden.

cards.question: Amaziah doesn't do right the way King David had. Instead, he does everything as his ___ Joash had done.

cards.text: Nevertheless, the high places are not taken away. They just stay put, like a junk drawer nobody ever cleans out, and trust me, friend, I LIVED in one.

cards.question: The high places are still standing in Amaziah's day. What do the people keep doing there?

cards.text: As soon as the kingdom is firmly in his grasp, Amaziah turns to some old business. Servants had murdered his father, King Joash.

cards.question: What does Amaziah do to the servants who murdered his father?

cards.text: Those murderers had sons. And Amaziah goes by what's written in the Book of the Law of Moses.

cards.question: True or false: Amaziah has the sons of his father's murderers put to death too.
Amaziah goes by the LORD's command in the Law of Moses: each person is to die for his ___ sin.

cards.text: Then Amaziah goes to war against the Edomites, the people descended from Esau (Genesis 36:9). The fight is in a place called the Valley of Salt.

cards.question: How many Edomites does Amaziah strike down in the Valley of Salt?
True or false: When Amaziah takes the city of Sela in battle, he gives it a new name.

cards.text: He calls it Joktheel, a name it still had when this was written. Me? I once renamed a burnt cookie EXTRA CRUNCHY.
Two big wins, and now Amaziah is looking north. He sends messengers to Jehoash king of Israel.

cards.question: What message does Amaziah, king of Judah, send to Jehoash king of Israel?

answers.text: Come and meet me face to face
Send me gold for my temple

cards.text: Jehoash king of Israel answers Amaziah with a little story. It starts in Lebanon, with a thistle and a cedar.

cards.question: In Jehoash's story, a thistle in Lebanon sends a message to a cedar in Lebanon. What does the thistle ask for?

answers.text: The cedar's daughter for its son
A place in the cedar's shade

cards.question: Then something else in Lebanon comes along. What happens to the thistle in Jehoash's story?

cards.text: A thistle talking weddings with a cedar is a guy in a studio apartment knocking on a mansion door like, "My son, your daughter, let's TALK." Then Jehoash drops the story and grants that Amaziah really did beat Edom.

cards.question: Jehoash tells Amaziah that after beating Edom, his heart has become ___.
So what does Jehoash tell Amaziah to do?

answers.text: Enjoy the win and stay home

cards.question: True or false: Jehoash warns Amaziah that if he stirs up trouble, he could fall and take Judah with him.
True or false: Amaziah listens to Jehoash's warning and stays home.

cards.text: Amaziah won't listen, so Jehoash king of Israel advances, and the two kings face each other at Beth-shemesh in Judah. Amaziah wanted face to face, and now he's GOT face to face.

cards.question: Judah and Israel clash at Beth-shemesh. How does the battle go for Judah?

answers.text: Judah is routed and runs home
The battle ends in a truce

cards.question: What happens to Amaziah himself at Beth-shemesh?

cards.text: With Amaziah captured, Jehoash goes to Jerusalem and breaks down four hundred cubits of the wall, from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate. That's not a hole in the wall, friend, that's a whole new DRIVEWAY.

cards.question: Jehoash takes all the gold and silver and articles he finds in Jerusalem. Where does he find them?

answers.text: The house of the LORD and the palace
The Tower of Hananel and the Fish Gate
The Water Gate and the Horse Gate

cards.question: True or false: Jehoash also takes some hostages and returns to Samaria.

cards.text: The rest of Jehoash's acts, his might and how he waged war against Amaziah are written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel. So Amaziah's worst day is written down, PERMANENTLY.
Jehoash rests with his fathers and is buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel. His son Jeroboam (not Jeroboam son of Nebat) reigns in his place.

cards.question: True or false: Amaziah king of Judah outlives Jehoash king of Israel.

cards.text: Amaziah lives fifteen more years after Jehoash dies.
The rest of Amaziah's acts are written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah. Then conspirators in Jerusalem plot against him, and he flees.

cards.question: Conspirators plot against Amaziah in Jerusalem. Where does he flee?
True or false: Once Amaziah reaches Lachish, he's safe from the conspirators.

cards.text: Men are sent after him, and they kill him there in Lachish. He's carried back on horses and buried with his fathers in Jerusalem, in the City of David.

cards.question: Who do the people of Judah make king in place of Amaziah?

cards.text: Azariah is Amaziah's son, just sixteen years old. He's the one who rebuilds Elath and restores it to Judah after Amaziah rests with his fathers.
